mapper.sql: customer_zones.id AS id, customer_zones.`name` AS name, customer_zones.lats AS lats, customer_zones.`longs` AS `longs`, customer_zones.radius AS radius, customer_zones.created AS created, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) AS createdBy, customer_zones.modified AS modified, CONCAT(editor.first_name, ' ', editor.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM customer_zones LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = customer_zones.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS editor ON editor.id = customer_zones.modified_by

WHERE customer_zones.is_active = 1
AND customer_zones.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.select: SELECT customer_zone_details.id AS id, customer_zone_details.lats AS lats, customer_zone_details.`longs` AS `longs` FROM customer_zone_details WHERE customer_zone_details.customer_zone_id = #{zoneId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_zones ( `name`, lats, `longs`, radius, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{zone.name}, #{zone.lats}, #{zone.longs}, #{zone.radius}, NOW(), #{zone.createdBy}, #{zone.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_zones SET `name` = #{zone.name}, lats = #{zone.lats}, `longs` = #{zone.longs}, radius = #{zone.radius}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{zone.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{zone.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE customer_zones SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
